data.assumption: “रिफ़ंड दर” को UAE में अगस्त 2026 के दौरान business_date वाले, सफल card payment_attempt से भुगतान किए गए non-test फ़ोन ऑर्डरों में से कम से कम एक succeeded refund वाले distinct orders का अनुपात माना गया है।
data.sql:
SELECT
  p.model_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS card_paid_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM refunds rf
    WHERE rf.order_id = o.order_id
      AND rf.status = 'succeeded'
  ) THEN o.order_id END) AS refunded_orders,
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM refunds rf
    WHERE rf.order_id = o.order_id
      AND rf.status = 'succeeded'
  ) THEN o.order_id END) AS DECIMAL(18,6))
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.sku = oi.sku
WHERE o.is_test = false
  AND s.country_code = 'AE'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND p.is_accessory = false
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payment_attempts pa
    WHERE pa.order_id = o.order_id
      AND pa.is_test = false
      AND pa.method = 'card'
      AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  )
GROUP BY p.model_name
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC, refunded_orders DESC, p.model_name
